description: Hand labels of the abstention detector replay: 102 answers drawn at random (seed 2026) within each group of LR-03 (9 per corpus-loss level) and of the register run registre-gc-1 (5 to 10 per phase), labelled by reading the answer only, before the rules were tuned. abstention = the answer says the information is not found, not in the sources, or that it cannot answer, and gives no answer; an answer that says the sources lack the information and then answers anyway (hedged) is labelled false. 'row' is the 0-based line of the runs.jsonl file.
